conventions.convention: All posterior stages are probability laws on the same measurable space, conditional on the same fixed observed data; different original state spaces require declared measurable embeddings and pushforward laws.
Retained draws are X_(b+1), …, X_(b+N), with b ≥ 0 and N ≥ 1; the chain starts at index zero.
Total variation is sup_A |μ(A)−ν(A)|; the bounded signed-functional comparison has constant 2M.

The invariant-law discrepancy compares μ_disc(f) with a specified invariant law π_K(f), rather than comparing one-step kernels. Missing invariant-law or error estimates remain unavailable or unquantified.
The sample-error branch assumes stationarity and absolutely summable lag covariances; it supplies a finite-N mean-square bound, without asserting a CLT or confidence interval.
The reported ESS is theoretical and functional-specific, computed from the stationary autocorrelation sequence; it is neither an empirical finite-run estimate nor a CLT assertion.

load_bearing.statement: For a bounded measurable real functional and the declared common-space posterior stages, specified invariant law, and Markov chain, the posterior computation error budget is the sum of the six absolute adjacent differences: model, solver, discretization, invariant-law, burn-in, and centered Monte Carlo errors.

For probability measures μ,ν on the same measurable space and measurable real f with |f| ≤ M < ∞, |μ(f)−ν(f)| ≤ 2M‖μ−ν‖TV. The complete budget bounds |μ_star(f)−f̄_(b,N)| pathwise. Separately, for a stationary Markov chain with initial invariant law π_K and absolutely summable lag covariances γ_k, E|f̄_(b,N)−π_K(f)|² = [Nγ_0+2∑_(k=1)^(N−1)(N−k)γ_k]/N² ≤ [γ_0+2∑_(k≥1)|γ_k|]/N.

concerns.concern: Proof 1.2 says the successive references have 'signed adjacent differences whose sum is μ_star(f)−f̄_(b,N)'. The cited ledger defines each signed difference as the later reference minus the earlier reference, so their sum is f̄_(b,N)−μ_star(f). Taking absolute values gives the stated bound either way; the signed identity in this sentence has its orientation reversed. The definition's directed diagram correctly follows the earlier-to-later reference order.
